instructor_intent: Instructor Intent cua giang vien cho Lesson 6: Sau bai hoc vien PHAI phan biet retriever vs reranker. KHONG can dao sau BM25. Loi pho bien cua cohort truoc: tuong reranker thay duoc retriever (sai). Neu chi nho mot dieu: retriever loc nhanh top-50, reranker xep lai top-5.
note: 4 nguon Tier-1 chot cho dot CP3. GUI API NGOAI QUA PROMPT (paste nguyen file), khong retrieval nen khong dilution. Chi gui excerpt toi thieu (quy tac bao mat data pack).

sources.text: Lesson 6 - RAG + Reranking, 24 phut, 18 slides. Pipeline: retrieve bang retriever lay top-50, rerank bang reranker (cross-encoder) chon top-5, generate cau tra loi. [02:10] Bai dung embedding de giang dense retrieval ma KHONG dinh nghia lai embedding. [Slide 6] Bai gia dinh chunk 500 tokens, overlap 50 ma khong giang lai chunking. [09:00] Reranking duoc day ky trong bai (cross-encoder cham tung cap query-document). [14:20] Giai thich: reranker KHONG thay duoc retriever. Sau bai hoc vien phai: (1) giai thich pipeline RAG retrieve-rerank-generate, (2) phan biet retriever vs reranker, (3) ap dung reranking khi top-k nhieu.

sources.text: Transcript Lesson 3, doan 18:40: embedding la cach bien mot doan text thanh mot vector so, sao cho hai cau gan nghia thi vector gan nhau. Do bang cosine similarity. Vi du truc quan cosine tren slide Lesson 3.

sources.text: Slide Lesson 4, trang 14-17: chunk 500 tokens, overlap 50 tokens de giu mach ngu canh giua 2 chunk. Minh hoa dut mach khi overlap bang 0. Rule: cau hoi can cross-chunk thi tang overlap. Dependency: chunking xau thi retrieval xau du reranker tot.
